domain: Survey Research & Official Statistics (census, register and administrative data quality)

distractor_reasons.lhecb_fy2026_state_appropriations.xlsx: the state's fiscal 2026 appropriations by campus, made to branches directly; the grant ranks instruction expense, which the appropriation does not measure
distractor_reasons.lhecb_2026-27_tuition_and_fees.csv: 2026-27 tuition and fees; a price, not an expense, and of the wrong year
distractor_reasons.ipeds_gr2025_graduation_rates_lakemoor_p: graduation rates of the 2019 cohort; an outcome the grant does not rank on

sources.constructed: every file is constructed for this task by its generator (task482/generator); the state, the board, the campuses, their students and the people are fictional
sources.public_specifications: the federal files follow the IPEDS directory (HD), finance (F1A, GASB) and 12-month enrollment (E12) layouts and variable names, including the finance parent/child indicator PRCH_F and parent UNITID IDX_F; the state files are a coordinating board's own layouts, described in the pack's dictionary
